angle: A free MIT-licensed skill bundle that loads bug-hunting expertise into Claude Code, with scope and authorisation built in.

claims.text: claude-bughunter is a Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work with 83 skills (the README; the repository description says 82), so "over eighty" holds either way.
The repository has more than eight thousand stars (8,975 and 1,345 forks per the GitHub API on 2026-11-17) and an MIT licence.

Install it as a Claude Code plugin (/plugin marketplace add elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter, then /plugin install claude-bughunter@elementalsouls) or by cloning and running the install script; then describe what you are testing in plain English and the relevant skill loads automatically.
Skills load by topic, covering recon and OSINT, web-app hunting, enterprise platforms, and reporting and validation.
The bundle ships 15 slash commands and 681 disclosed-report patterns across 24 core vulnerability classes.
The workflow has a 7-Question Gate before anything is submitted, and its question 3 asks whether the asset is in scope.

The skills are intended for assets you own or have written authorization to assess: in-scope bug-bounty programmes, authorised pentests with a signed rules of engagement, CTFs, your own infrastructure and lab targets.
